items.note: Panel is a web app (vite), not in the Play build, so target API, billing and permission rules do not reach these screens. Every WhatsApp use here is click-to-chat: the desk person opens one chat and sends it from their own phone, with a polite editable message; no bulk or automatic sending in these files (assistant bulk case already FN-L12-panel-assistant-01). Ready diet plans say not medical advice, make no result promises, and offer the doctor line. Play policy page clean. Whether the phone app's data safety form lists member photos and body measurements taken here could not be seen: the Play report does not include the form.
